title: Differences in macrophage pyroptosis and polarization induced by nano-/micro-calcium oxalate crystals.

sections.heading: Methods
sections.text: Methods COM crystals with sizes of about 100 nm, 500 nm, 2.5 μm, and 10 μm were synthesized and characterized. THP-1 cells were induced to differentiate into macrophage-like cells. The damage of COM crystals to Mφs was evaluated by CCK-8 assay. The activation of the pyroptosis signaling pathway, cell morphology, and proportion of pyroptosis cells in Mφs induced by COM crystals were detected. Finally, the proportion of M1/M2 polarization was qualitatively and quantitatively assessed.

sections.heading: Materials and methods
Synthesis and characterization of COM crystals
sections.text:
Synthesis and characterization of COM crystals Synthesis of COM crystals According to reference [ 27 ], 100 nm COM and 10 μm COM crystals were synthesized, and 500 nm COM and 2.5 μm COM were newly synthesized on this basis. In this paper, COM crystals with different sizes were designated as COM-100 nm, COM-500 nm, COM-2.5 μm, and COM-10 μm. The synthesis conditions are shown in Table  1 . Table 1 Synthesis conditions of COM crystals of different sizes Crystal Temperature (℃) Mixing manner Dropping time (min) Stirring time (min) c (Ca 2+ ) (mmol/L) c (Ox 2− ) (mmol/L) Stirring speed (rpm) COM-100 nm 25 Directly mixed 0 6 300 300 1250 COM-500 nm 60 Directly mixed 0 5 20 20 1200 COM-2.5 μm 60 2 drops/1 s
for 12 min
 12 2 5 5 1200 COM-10 μm 75 1 drop/2 s
for 30 min 30 2 5 5 400 COM-100 nm: At room temperature, CaCl 2  (0.6 mol/L, 50 mL) solution was quickly mixed with K 2 Ox (0.6 mol/L, 50 mL) solution, and the reaction was stirred at 1250 rpm for 6 min before centrifugation. The products were ultrasonically washed twice with absolute ethanol, filtered, and dried to obtain COM crystals with a size of about 100 nm. COM-500 nm: CaCl 2  (0.04 mol/L, 50 mL) and K 2 Ox (0.04 mol/L, 50 mL) solutions were heated to 60 ℃, mixed directly, and kept at 60 ℃ for 5 min under stirring at 1200 rpm. After standing overnight, the products were ultrasonically washed twice with absolute ethanol, filtered, and dried to obtain COM crystals with a size of about 500 nm. COM-2.5 μm: CaCl 2  (0.04 mol/L, 50 mL) solution was added to 300 mL of ultrapure water, and K 2 Ox (0.04 mol/L, 50 mL) solution was added at 60 ℃ with a dropping speed of 2 drops/1 s, and the adding time was about 12 min. The reaction was always maintained at 60 ℃ and stirred at 1200 rpm. The mixture was stirred continuously for 5 min, placed at room temperature overnight, washed twice with absolute ethanol, filtered, and dried to obtain COM crystals with a size of about 2.5 nm. COM-10 μm: Similar to synthetic COM-3 μm, but with a reduced drop rate (drop rate of 1 drop/2 s, adding time of about 30 min) and stirring speed (400 rpm). Characterization of COM crystals 
 Crystal morphology and size observed by SEM About 1 mg of COM crystals was weighed, dispersed in 10 mL of absolute ethanol, and sonicated for 3 min to form a suspension. The above suspension was dropped onto 10 mm × 10 mm slides and dried at 50 ℃. Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) was used to observe the size and morphology of COM crystals. Nano Measurer 1.2 software was used to measure the size of the photographed samples, and the statistics were normally fitted in Origin (Version 2021, OriginLab Corporation, Northampton, MA, USA) software. The size range of the sample was obtained. X-ray diffraction An appropriate amount of COM crystal samples was analyzed using an X-ray diffractometer. The test conditions were CuKᾱ rays, graphite monochromator, 30 kV, 25 mA, scanning range of 5–600, scanning speed of 80/min, and step width of 0.020/s.

sections.heading: Experimental grouping
sections.text: Experimental grouping THP-1 cells were plated at a density of 10 6  cells/mL. The experiment was divided into three groups: (a) normal control group (NC): THP-1 cells were cultured in RPMI-1640 medium without serum; (b) differentiation group: THP-1 cells were induced to Mφs by incubation in complete culture medium containing 5 ng/mL PMA for 24 h, followed by resting for 24 h [ 28 ]; and (c) blank background group: serum-free RPMI-1640 medium only.

Characterization of COM crystals 
 Crystal morphology and size observed by SEM About 1 mg of COM crystals was weighed, dispersed in 10 mL of absolute ethanol, and sonicated for 3 min to form a suspension.
The above suspension was dropped onto 10 mm × 10 mm slides and dried at 50 ℃.
The medium was changed by replenishing or partially exchanging the fluid and passaged by centrifugation.
After cell attachment, the original culture medium was aspirated and washed once with PBS.

Each well was fixed with 1.5 mL of 4% paraformaldehyde for 15 min, stained with hematoxylin staining solution for 15 min, rinsed with water to remove excess staining solution, added with eosin staining solution to stain for 90 s, rinsed with water to remove excess staining solution, observed by an inverted fluorescence microscope, and photographed.
After cells were seeded on slides and differentiated, the cells were fixed using 4% paraformaldehyde fixative for 15 min and then washed three times with PBS.
The cells were permeabilized for 10 min and washed three times with PBS.
The cells were blocked with blocking solution for 1 h and washed three times with PBS.
The cells were incubated at 4 ℃ overnight after dilution of the CD68 primary antibody at the prescribed ratio and washed three times with PBS.
The cells were incubated for 70 min after dilution of the secondary antibody at the prescribed proportions and washed three times with PBS.
The nuclei were stained with DAPI for 5 min and washed three times with PBS.
After differentiation, COM crystals were added to each well at concentrations of 0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, and 2.5 mg/mL and incubated for 24 h to induce cellular damage.
Subsequently, 10 μL of CCK-8 solution was added to each well of the 96-well plate, and incubation was continued for 1 h in the cell incubator.
Upon completion of the incubation period, the culture medium was removed, and cells were washed with PBS and lysed by RIPA as described.
The supernatants were centrifuged and collected, and the total protein concentration in the supernatants was calculated using the BCA quantification method.

SDS was added to the collected supernatant and denatured at 100 ℃ for 10 min. Proteins were separated by SDS-PAGE, and the separated proteins were transferred to NC membranes and blocked with 5% skim milk for 2 h. Primary antibodies (NLRP3, ASC, GSDMD-N, pro-caspase-1, cleaved caspase-1 p20, and pro-IL-1β) were incubated overnight at 4 ℃ with slow shaking.
When the incubation time was reached, the cells were washed twice with PBS, and the cell morphology was observed under a fluorescent microscope.
Subsequently, cells were fixed with electron microscope fixative overnight at 4 ℃ and washed three times with PBS.
The cells were dehydrated with gradient concentrations of ethanol (25%, 50%, 70%, 90%, and 100%), subjected to critical point drying with CO 2 , and sprayed with gold.
After the incubation time, the cells were washed twice with PBS.
The cells were incubated in PI working solution for 30 min at 4 ℃ and washed twice with PBS.

After treatment, the cells were incubated at 37 ℃ in the dark for 1 h with FAM-YVAD-FMK solution, washed twice with the wash solution provided by the FLICA caspase-1 detection kit, and incubated at room temperature in the dark for 10 min with PI staining solution.
After the incubation time, the cells were washed twice with PBS and stained with FAM-YVAD-FMK solution for 1 h.
The staining solution was removed, and the cells were washed three times with PBS.
About 300 μL of Hoechst 33342 working solution (10 μg/mL) was added and stained for 10 min.
The staining solution was removed, and the cells were washed three times with PBS.
Subsequently, 300 μL of PI working solution (10 μg/mL) was added and stained for 10 min.
The staining solution was removed by aspiration, and the cells were washed with PBS for three times and observed under laser confocal microscopy.
After the incubation time, the cells were washed twice with PBS and operated according to the instructions of the IL-1β ELISA kit and IL-18 ELISA kit.
After the incubation time, the cells were washed twice with PBS.
The cells were fixed using 4% paraformaldehyde fixative for 15 min and washed three times with PBS.
After fixation, the cells were permeabilized (only in the detection of iNOS) for 10 min and washed three times with PBS.
The staining solution was removed, and the cells were washed three times with PBS and observed by laser confocal microscopy.
The staining solution was removed, and the cells were washed three times with PBS.

COM-500 nm: CaCl 2  (0.04 mol/L, 50 mL) and K 2 Ox (0.04 mol/L, 50 mL) solutions were heated to 60 ℃, mixed directly, and kept at 60 ℃ for 5 min under stirring at 1200 rpm.
After standing overnight, the products were ultrasonically washed twice with absolute ethanol, filtered, and dried to obtain COM crystals with a size of about 500 nm.

μm: CaCl 2  (0.04 mol/L, 50 mL) solution was added to 300 mL of ultrapure water, and K 2 Ox (0.04 mol/L, 50 mL) solution was added at 60 ℃ with a dropping speed of 2 drops/1 s, and the adding time was about 12 min.
The reaction was always maintained at 60 ℃ and stirred at 1200 rpm.
The mixture was stirred continuously for 5 min, placed at room temperature overnight, washed twice with absolute ethanol, filtered, and dried to obtain COM crystals with a size of about 2.5 nm.
COM-10 μm: Similar to synthetic COM-3 μm, but with a reduced drop rate (drop rate of 1 drop/2 s, adding time of about 30 min) and stirring speed (400 rpm).

methods_paragraphs.text: Experimental grouping THP-1 cells were plated at a density of 10 6  cells/mL. The experiment was divided into three groups: (a) normal control group (NC): THP-1 cells were cultured in RPMI-1640 medium without serum; (b) differentiation group: THP-1 cells were induced to Mφs by incubation in complete culture medium containing 5 ng/mL PMA for 24 h, followed by resting for 24 h [ 28 ]; and (c) blank background group: serum-free RPMI-1640 medium only.
